name: Wireless Device Manager Pro
description:
Turn Stream Deck into a wireless device dashboard for Windows.

Wireless Device Manager Pro combines Bluetooth device status, supported USB/2.4 GHz peripheral telemetry, wireless battery visibility, low-battery alerts, favorites, device groups, and capability-gated connect/disconnect control in one place. Give dedicated keys to headphones, a headset, keyboard, mouse, controller, earbuds, or another supported wireless peripheral. Initial direct USB/HID support includes the LAMZU Maya X in receiver and wired charging modes.

Every detected device advertises its own STATUS, CONNECT, DISCONNECT, BATTERY, and CHARGING capabilities. Device-reported battery percentage and charging state are never invented. If Windows or a supported device protocol does not expose telemetry, PackRat marks that capability unavailable. Connect/disconnect appears only where a reliable Windows Bluetooth control path is supported.

Create groups such as GAMING, WORK, or TRAVEL to organize and summarize the devices you care about. Groups are status/organization tools; PackRat does not blindly auto-connect every wireless device. Favorites power Cycle Device, while Device Dashboard gives a multi-device status view. Per-device low-battery thresholds can alert you on Stream Deck when a supported battery drops below your chosen level.

Ready-made Standard, Mini, XL, Stream Deck+ and Stream Deck Neo profiles use device-neutral controls, an ALL DEVICES dashboard, Cycle Device, and separate group workflow pages. Stream Deck+ uses keys only because a dial would add no legitimate wireless-device control.

Windows 10 or newer. No separate companion app, account, cloud service, or customer-installed helper is required.

Part of the PackRat ecosystem.
release_notes:
- Multi-device Bluetooth and supported USB/HID wireless dashboard
- LAMZU Maya X battery and charging telemetry over 2.4 GHz receiver or wired USB
- Favorites, Cycle Device, groups, and per-device low-battery thresholds
- Capability-gated audio connect/disconnect on supported Bluetooth devices
- Standard, Mini, XL, Stream Deck+, and Neo key-only profiles
